up: For assay CHEMBL4649953, return the exact activity values (standard_value, standard_units, standard_type, standard_relation) and the chemical structures (canonical_smiles) for the compounds tested. Include the molecule CHEMBL ID and pref_name.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM assays ass
JOIN activities a ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649953'
